source_text: Abraham in Geraris: Sara soror mea. Timor Dei non in loco. Deus claudit vulvas domus Abimelech propter Saram.
pass_a_gloss: Abraham in Gerar: Sarah sister my. Fear of-God not in place. God closes wombs of-house of-Abimelech because-of Sarah.
pass_b_english: Abraham in Gerar: [[She is my sister >> Bible:Genesis 20:2]]. Fear of God was not in that place. [[God closed every womb of Abimelech’s house because of Sarah >> Bible:Genesis 20:18]].
